learning_outcomes.text: After the course, students can analyze the operation of small alternating- and direct-current circuits with suitable methods.
They understand the concepts of complex effect, filters, etc., and can deepen their knowledge in future courses.

syllabus_topics: The basic circuit elements: resistance, capacitance, inductance, independent and controlled sources, operational amplifiers and transformer.
Analysis methods for DC and AC circuits: circuit transformations, mesh, nodal, superposition, Thevenen's, and Norton's methods.
Power matching and reactive power compensation.
